EXPLANATIONS 
 
* Subject/Course:   
mandatory – O   
mandatory with choice – OzW 
 
Forms of conducting classes: 
W – lecture 
Ć – exercises  
S – seminar  
K – conversion course  
 
Ways of verification of learning outcomes: 
E – exam 
Z - pass 
Zo– pass/fail 
 
1 The foreigner is obliged to complete a Polish Language for Foreigners course in semesters I-II, in a total of 60 hours, in accordance with 
separate regulations. 
2 The student is obliged to complete a foreign language course at the level of B2 until the end of semester IV. 
3 The student is obliged to complete two terms (60 hours) of physical education until the end of semester V.  
4 The student prepares the graduation thesis and prepares for the final exam supervised individually by the supervisor. The total expected 
workload associated is 300 hours, respectively in semester V: 150 hours, in semester VI: 150 hours.
